subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should sanitized model preambles become an always-on progress headline on Discord and Telegram when the opt-in commentary lane is disabled?
rationale: This is a new default user-visible status source with no configuration switch; mechanical correctness fixes cannot determine whether that permanent channel behavior matches product intent.

options.title: Approve always-on headlines
options.body: Use fresh sanitized preambles as the default delayed progress headline while leaving the explicitly enabled commentary lane in full control of its preamble events.

options.title: Keep narration-only defaults
options.body: Land the time-gate and no-before-visible narration fixes but keep model preambles behind the existing commentary option.

options.title: Add explicit configuration
options.body: Make preamble headlines opt-in, accepting another public config surface and its associated documentation and upgrade obligations.

recommendation.title: Approve always-on headlines
recommendation.body: Use fresh sanitized preambles as the default delayed progress headline while leaving the explicitly enabled commentary lane in full control of its preamble events.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history most directly connects this person to the shared progress-draft design whose default behavior is being changed.
